sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... UPR LOW/TROUGH LOCATED FROM THE CNTRL GREAT LAKES TO THE LWR OH VLY EARLY TODAY WILL SLOWLY ADVANCE ESE INTO THE NERN STATES...MID-ATLANTIC AND SERN ATLANTIC STATES BY EVE. A LEAD WAVE...CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER THE WV/KY COALFIELDS WILL EJECT ENE INTO THE NRN MID-ATLANTIC REGION BY AFTN. TO THE W...STRONG UPR RIDGE WILL BUILD NWD IN WAKE OF THE ERN SYSTEM...SPANNING THE PLAINS AND ERN ROCKIES. SUBTROPICAL DISTURBANCE OVER THE UT/AZ BORDER WILL UNDERCUT THE RIDGE...REACHING THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS BY LATE SUNDAY AFTN. MEANWHILE...POSITIVE-TILT UPR TROUGH OVER BC/NRN PAC BASIN WILL EDGE EWD INTO THE PAC NW WITH WEAK LEAD PV-FILAMENTS BRUSHING THE NRN ROCKIES.

sections.title: MID-OH VLY/CNTRL APLCNS/MID-ATLC SWD TO SE ATLC REGION
sections.text: LEAD WAVE EJECTING ENE AHEAD OF THE PRIMARY UPR TROUGH WILL BE SUPPORTING SVRL TSTM CLUSTERS FROM THE MID-ATLC REGION SWD INTO THE CAROLINAS EARLY IN THE PD. WHILE RESIDUAL CLOUDS/PCPN WILL TEMPER STRONG DESTABILIZATION...PRELIM THOUGHTS ARE THAT AIR MASS WILL MODESTLY HEAT IN THE LEE OF THE APLCNS FROM NEAR THE MASON-DIXON LINE SWD INTO SE GA AS EARLY DAY ACTIVITY PROGRESSES ENE. RICH MOISTURE /PWATS IN EXCESS OF 1.75 INCHES/ AND STEEPENING MID-LVL LAPSE RATES ASSOCIATED WITH THE PRIMARY UPR SYSTEM WILL YIELD POCKETS OF MLCAPES TO 1500 J/KG. EXPECT STORMS WILL DEVELOP/ GRADUALLY INCREASE ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN/LEE TROUGH/EXISTING OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM MD/VA SWD INTO THE WRN PIEDMONT OF THE CAROLINAS AND ECNTRL GA DURING THE MID-AFTN AND MOVE EWD INTO THE COASTAL PLAINS BY EARLY EVENING. BELT OF 30-40 KTS OF WSW MID-LVL FLOW ALONG BASE OF THE UPR TROUGH WILL FAVOR A FEW ORGANIZED STORMS /BOWS AND BRIEF SUPERCELLS/ WITH SVR WINDS AND LARGE HAIL... PARTICULARLY FROM CNTRL/ERN VA SWD INTO CNTRL NC. MEANWHILE...AT LEAST WDLY SCTD STRONG-SVR TSTMS WILL LIKELY EVOLVE BENEATH PRIMARY UPR LOW/VCNTY OCCLUDED SFC LOW/FRONT OVER THE MID-OH VLY/CNTRL APLCNS DURING PEAK HEATING. HERE...MID-

sections.title: HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: THE LEE TROUGH/LOW WILL STRENGTHEN ALONG THE PALMER DIVIDE NWD INTO WRN NEB SUNDAY AFTN AS THE AFOREMENTIONED SUB-TROPICAL IMPULSE APPROACHES THE REGION. HIGH-BASED STORMS WILL FORM READILY IN THE CO/SRN WY MOUNTAINS THROUGH THE AFTN WITH GUSTY WINDS PSBL. HEATING ALONG THE WRN FRINGE OF LWR-MID 60S SFC DEW POINTS FARTHER E ON THE HIGH PLAINS WILL PROBABLY WEAKEN MLCINH SUFFICIENTLY FOR A FEW OF THE EARLY STORMS TO EVENTUALLY ROOT INTO MLCAPES OF 2000-2500 J/KG FROM SWRN NEB TO THE PALMER DIVIDE REGION. SSELY LLVL FLOW OF 20-25 KTS TOPPED BY WSW MID-LVL WINDS OF 30 KTS WILL YIELD SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL/HIGH WINDS. ACTIVITY WILL PROGRESS ENE AND BECOME INCREASINGLY ELEVATED DURING THE EVENING/OVERNIGHT INTO PARTS OF CNTRL NEB/NCNTRL KS ALONG THE NOSE OF A 45-50 KT LLVL JET. ..RACY.. 08/14/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: OH UPR LOW EXPECTED TO MOVE SLOWLY ESE AND DEVOLVE INTO AN OPEN WAVE THIS PERIOD AS UPSTREAM RIDGE PROGRESSES FROM THE RCKYS/HI PLNS INTO THE PLNS...AND A SEASONABLY STRONG TROUGH ENTERS THE PACIFIC NW. ON THE N SIDE OF THE RIDGE...AN IMPULSE TRACKING ENE FROM THE FOUR CORNERS SHOULD REACH ERN CO BY EVE...WHILE A DISTURBANCE ASSOCIATED WITH THE OH TROUGH...NOW OVER ERN KY/TN...CONTINUES ENE TO THE LWR CHESAPEAKE BAY. FEATURES WILL REMAIN WEAK AT THE SFC. ILL-DEFINED LOW NOW OVER THE UPR OH VLY SHOULD REDEVELOP ESE INTO CNTRL MD BY THIS EVE AS ITS TRAILING COLD FRONT CRESTS THE CNTRL/SRN APPALACHIANS. FARTHER W...LEE TROUGH EXPECTED TO REMAIN NEARLY STNRY OVER THE CNTRL/NRN HI PLNS.

sections.title: MID OH VLY TO MID/S ATLANTIC CST THIS TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: ERN KY/TN WAVE AND BACKING LWR TROPOSPHERIC FLOW/ASCENT AHEAD OF IT WILL MAINTAIN CLUSTERS/BANDS OF REGENERATIVE/BACK-BUILDING TSTMS FROM THE CAROLINAS NEWD INTO ERN PA/NJ/SERN NY/SW NE ENGLAND TODAY. CLOUDS/PCPN WILL TEMPER DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION. BUT POCKETS OF HEATING WILL OCCUR...ESPECIALLY FROM THE CHESAPEAKE BAY S INTO THE CNTRL/ERN CAROLINAS. COUPLED WITH MID LVL COOL ADVECTION AND CONTINUED LOW LVL MOISTURE INFLOW /SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 70S F AND PW AROUND 2 INCHES/...EXPECT SBCAPE TO AVERAGE AOA 1500 J PER KG OVER THE VA...CAROLINA PIEDMONT/CSTL PLN. STORMS OVER THE REGION SHOULD GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE/STRENGTH...WITH NEW ACTIVITY LIKELY OVER THE ERN SLOPES OF THE SRN AND CNTRL APPALACHIANS...ALONG COLD FRONT...AND ALONG EXISTING OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES BY MID AFTN. BELT OF 30+ KT WSWLY 500 MB FLOW IN BASE OF UPR TROUGH WILL FOSTER STORM ORGANIZATION/SUSTENANCE...INCLUDING SMALL BOWING STRUCTURES AND PERHAPS A FEW WEAKLY ROTATING STORMS. THESE MAY YIELD SVR WIND AND HAIL...ESPECIALLY FROM CNTRL/ERN VA SWD INTO CNTRL AND ERN PARTS OF THE CAROLINAS THIS AFTN/EARLY TNGT. FARTHER W AND NW...MORE WDLY SCTD STRONG-SVR TSTMS MAY OCCUR FOLLOWING PEAK HEATING OVER THE MID/UP

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL TROUGH OVER THE UPPER OH VALLEY WILL DRIFT EWD/SEWD AS EMBEDDED SPEED MAXIMA ROTATE AROUND THE SRN PERIPHERY OF THE WAVE NEAR THE SRN APPALACHIANS. THE MIDLEVEL WAVE WILL BE ACCOMPANIED BY SURFACE LOW AND COLD FRONT WHICH WILL CROSS THE CENTRAL/SRN APPALACHIANS LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. FARTHER W...MIDLEVEL HIGH WILL PERSIST OVER THE SRN PLAINS...WITH A RIDGE EXTENDING NWD ACROSS THE PLAINS...AND AN UPSTREAM TROUGH OVER THE PAC NW. IN THE LOW LEVELS...A LEE TROUGH WILL BE MAINTAINED TODAY INTO TONIGHT FROM ERN CO NWD TO ERN MT.

sections.title: MID AND SE ATLANTIC AREA THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: THE PRIMARY MIDLEVEL LOW WILL DRIFT EWD FROM OH TOWARD WRN PA/WV...WHILE EMBEDDED SPEED MAXIMA ROTATE SEWD/EWD FROM THE OH VALLEY TOWARD THE CAROLINAS. ASCENT WITH THESE FEATURES WILL SPREAD EWD FROM ERN KY/TN TO WRN VA AND THE WRN CAROLINAS THIS AFTERNOON. THIS WILL COINCIDE WITH SLOW EWD PROGRESS OF A LEE TROUGH ACROSS THE PIEDMONT AND JUST E OF THE BLUE RIDGE...WHERE CLOUD BREAKS WILL ALLOW SURFACE TEMPERATURES TO WARM INTO THE LOW 80S THIS AFTERNOON. MLCAPE IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE TO NEAR 1500 J/KG ALONG THE SURFACE TROUGH...AND 1500-2000 J/KG FARTHER E ACROSS THE COASTAL PLAINS WHERE BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS ARE WELL INTO THE 70S. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP BY MID AFTERNOON NEAR OR JUST E OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN FROM WRN VA TO THE WRN CAROLINAS...AND STORMS WILL SUBSEQUENTLY SPREAD EWD/SEWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON EVENING. THE PRIMARY CONCERN FOR THIS AREA WILL BE THE LINGERING CLOUDS AND THEIR IMPACT ON AFTERNOON INSTABILITY. HOWEVER...A GRADUAL INCREASE IN MIDLEVEL FLOW AND LOW-LEVEL DESTABILIZATION WILL PROMOTE A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS WITH THE STRONGER STORMS...AND PERHAPS SOME MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL.

sections.title: CENTRAL/NRN HIGH PLAINS AREAS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WILL SPREAD NWD/NWWD TO THE E OF THE LEE TROUGH...WITH BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS OF 55-60 F EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS ERN MT...AND LOW-MID 60S FARTHER S INTO THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. AFTERNOON TEMPERATURES WILL WARM TO NEAR 90 ALONG THE LEE TROUGH BENEATH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...RESULTING IN MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2500 J/KG. ALOFT...A SERIES OF EMBEDDED SPEED MAXIMA WILL EJECT ENEWD FROM UT/ID/SW MT TO THE CENTRAL/NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. WEAK ASCENT WITH THE EJECTING WAVES ALOFT...WEAKENING OF CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WITH DAYTIME HEATING...AND LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE/ASCENT ALONG THE LEE TROUGH WILL SUPPORT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...WITH THE MORE PROBABLE AREAS OF STORM FORMATION ACROSS NE CO/NW KS/SW NEB...AND NE MT. STORMS THAT FORM IN EITHER AREA WILL DO SO IN AN ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. ..THOMPSON/COHEN.. 08/14/2011

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ...MID AND SE ATLANTIC AREA... MAIN CHANGES WERE TO PULL THE WRN END OF THE SLIGHT RISK WWD TO ACCOUNT FOR STORMS LOCATED ALONG THE SYNOPTIC FRONT FROM WV SWWD INTO FAR ERN TN. ALSO SHIFTED 30% WIND PROBABILITY WWD TO ACCOUNT FOR MORE COVERAGE OF SEVERE AS FRONTAL STORMS SHIFT EWD INTO MORE STRONGLY HEATED AIR MASS.

sections.title: MT
sections.text: PROBABILITY OF SEVERE STORMS IN FAR NERN MT APPEARS A LITTLE LESS THAN EARLIER THOUGHT AS SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS NOW PASSING THROUGH NORTH CENTRAL MT. ONLY WEAK MID LEVEL CONVECTION HAS DEVELOPED TO THIS POINT AND EXPECT SURFACE BASED CONVECTION TO DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTERNOON...BUT GIVEN THE CURRENT TRACK OF SYSTEM...THESE STORMS APPEAR MORE LIKELY TO DEVELOP IN SRN CANADA.

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW MOVING THROUGH WRN CO IS EXPECTED TO INITIATE STORMS OVER THE NERN CO/FAR SERN WY LATE THIS AFTERNOON...WITH SHEAR/INSTABILITY FAVORABLE FOR STORMS WITH HAIL/WIND...REFERENCE MD #1978. HIGH RESOLUTION MODELS SUGGEST STORMS MAY CONGEAL INTO AN MCS OVER CENTRAL NEB AROUND MID EVENING AS LOW LEVEL JET STRENGTHENS...WITH WIND DAMAGE A GREAT THREAT THAT TIME. ELEVATED STORMS NEAR THE SD/ND BORDER ARE BEING MAINTAINED BY WARM ADVECTION BETWEEN 700-850 MB. EFFECTIVE SHEAR BETWEEN 30-40 KT AND WLY MID LEVEL FLOW IS FEEDING SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY FOR A STORM OR TWO TO GENERATE MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. ..IMY.. 08/14/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1128 AM CDT SUN AUG 14 2011/
